programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. Sing along as Magic E makes mischief and shows you how to turn a cap into a cape.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Nugget’s new fitness device sparks a craze on the berg. Running, skating and jumping, the Piris battle it out to score the most points, with a surprise winner.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: The doctors visit Fifi and see that she is feeling sad because her pies aren’t up to her usual standard. They take her out to cheer her up - until Zog realises what she really needs.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Somebody stole the big hand off the clock tower. Mojo and Bo are on the case, but it is not as simple as it seems. Soon, they are pulling off a heist they never expected.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Sula, Pando and Bing discover a bird's nest while making a playhouse in the shed. They try to find the bird by being super quiet, and she flies into their playhouse. When Bing goes in to look for her, she flies out again; they can't both be in the playhouse at the same time. So Bing decides to give the shed to her until her chicks have all grown up.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘lizard’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. Today, we see a green lizard, a bright lizard, a long-tailed lizard, a running lizard and a climbing lizard. We meet a beady-eyed lizard, see a laughing lizard, and Dee even hangs out with a wizard lizard! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are out for a walk with Granny when they hear some interesting sounds coming from an old bell tower, and before long, they make friends with Ding, Dong, Bing and Bong - four creaky singing bells in need of some help!

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Keith wants to have a pirate adventure, so the Piggies build him a wheeled ship. Together, they sail across Fine Forest in search of treasure. When Wilf hears about their hunt, he joins the crew. But he only has one thing in mind... to steal the treasure!

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos find themselves in a hospital and watch a nurse wrapping a man's leg in bandages. When the nurse leaves the room, the Twirlywoos decide they'd like to have a go at wrapping bandages themselves. The Twirlywoos end up wrapping both of the man's legs to the bed, but he doesn't notice because he's too busy watching TV! On the Big Red Boat, the Piece of Paper visits the Twirlywoos and also wants to try wrapping. First Peekaboo is wrapped up, then Chickedy and Chick are wrapped up, followed by Toodloo and finally Great BigHoo. Eventually all the Twirlywoos are wrapped up together!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friend visit a very special football training ground, and the Tumble family take part in the Tumble Cup Final – who will take the trophy? The stars or the spots?

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies stand up straight to see who is the tallest and who is the shortest. Tinky Winky and Po play with the Tiddlytubbies, and the children in Tummy Tales put themselves in height order ready for a photograph to be taken.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Evie, Gracie, Luke, Joseph, Thea, Benjamin and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are eggboxes which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate eggboxes inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song Humpty Dumpty features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Baby Bear Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: Elsee visits a shopping centre with her friend George and plays a game of I-spy.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Horticulturist Brie introduces the Fact Pack to water lilies and explains how these amazing plants grow and live in water, and why they are so important in nature.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk to the park to feed the birds at the pond. On the way, they race like racing cars, spot the different coloured flowers, listen to the thunder and even meet a Stick Man tree!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri, Lou and their friends encounter extreme flatulence.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo squabble over their magic xylophone, which has the power to freeze Dad in space and time. Dad seizes control and freezes Bluey, leaving Bingo as her only hope.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are going camping. They need to find somewhere to pitch their tent but it's not as easy as they thought it would be. They all work together and finally get settled. But Tag realises he can't sleep without his teddy, and Happy would like a glass of water. Suddenly Duggee is up and down and in and out of the tent getting everything the Squirrels need. In fact, Duggee works so hard that he's the first to fall asleep.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Jessie finds out all about some very speedy teeny tiny creatures – lizards. Chantelle joins Tom and Harvey to discover what lizards eat. Meanwhile, Rory and his son Sandy are at a country park trying to find the super speedy creatures who are very good at hiding. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files explain the differences between lizards and newts, how big lizards grow and which species can change colour. It’s also time to find out how lizards help the planet as predators. This episode’s Teeny Tiny Task is to make some great lizard art.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Grandma comes to look after George and Freddie for the day and helps the boys make some special biscuits for Mum. There is extra excitement in store when it starts to snow. Will there be enough to build a snowman? Will Grandma brave the sledge? And what will mum think of those biscuits?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen makes a rain stick using rice, and Small wants one too. Isaac the inventor visits the cafe, Small flies off to find out how popcorn is made, and the chefs cook up cheesy corn clouds for their clever guest.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Rayane, Karim and Luca are having a sleepover, when hearing dog Diesel is woken in the middle of the night by a strange hissing noise. Is there a slithery snake in the kitchen?

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s Miss Gerrard’s birthday, and the children plan a surprise party for her. Felicity and Coen are the chefs. They are in charge of baking and decorating a delicious birthday cake, with help from Mrs Bailey. Theo and Jasper are making a beautiful birthday crown for Miss Gerrard to wear and have asked Mrs Hussain to help them. With everything ready, it’s time for the surprise party!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Marvin is having a bad, bad day - he has lost his favourite rock. Oona helps him look for another rock, but all the new ones are too small, too heavy or too pointy. It seems like no other rock will do until Oona spots the seagulls with Marvin's old rock. She comes up with a plan to help him get it back!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: TapTap becomes very protective when strange eggs appear in the branches of her tree, so everyone helps keep the garden nice and quiet. TapTap is amazed to find that her eggs are in fact chrysalises, from which some beautiful musical butterflies emerge!

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: When Triggs's chewy ball gets lost, Maddie and Triggs discover a whole world run by the Dust Bunnies - the tiny creatures who keep all the stuff that ends up under the couch! Can Maddie and Triggs convince them that they are caring and responsible enough to get their ball back?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: The Piggies are struggling with a tricky game. When Fiona asks for help tidying her garden, they bring the toy along - but they get distracted and make an even bigger mess. Can they play and work at the same time?

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a bedtime story all about Numberblocks Sixteen to Twenty. Learn all about the numbers 16, 17, 18, 19 and 20 with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: OI, OR and UR are in a coin-rolling, cork-popping, wave-surfing mad dash to prove who is the fastest! This episode introduces the '-oi-', '-or-' and '-ur-' digraphs and the words join, coin, cork, surf, turf, cord, corn and end.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends go on a roarsome adventure to a dinosaur park, while Mr Tumble visits Shopkeeper Tumble in The Shop with the Lot to buy Tumble Ted a birthday present.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: In Tummy Tales, a group of children watch a plane loop the loop in the air, whilst the Teletubbies have magical fun watching a shooting star loop the loop. Later, the Tubby Toast goes loop the loop too as it flies out of the Tubby Toaster.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: The animals are napping but Alcatraz the tortoise wants to play. Ranger Hamza spots some wonderful waterbuck in the wild and learns how to prepare a cosy bed for the elephants.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Caitlin wants to make Daisy and Mack’s anniversary perfect. When the other kids are roped in to help, the second first date doesn’t go quite as Caitlin imagined.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that are all forms of transport! Grace drives a double decker bus, shows off an ice sled that is like a bus on ice, and then takes an electric Hackney carriage for a spin.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: Miss Collie challenges the pups to build a raft to carry a dog biscuit across a paddling pool. Woofer and Jazz both have great ideas for building the raft, but Dodge can't decide whose idea is better. All the other teams are creating some impressive rafts before Dodge, Woofer and Jazz have even started. The pups learn that working together is the key to success.

programme.title: The Summit
programme.desc: Thrilling reality adventure series hosted by Ben Shephard. The 14 ordinary Brits who set off to climb one of New Zealand's highest peaks have now been reduced to nine as the treacherous terrain and brutal vote-offs claim more victims - in a dramatic twist, one of the group is now given an agonising decision by the Mountain's Keeper to choose someone to leave the mountain. After the emotional repercussions see everyone beginning to think more strategically, tensions increase when they are forced to camp in the wild and the group start to plot against one another - the following day leads to an encounter with a vast glacial lake that the climbers must cross to reach the next base camp. However, the Mountain's Keeper once more gets in on the act and forces the group into a situation which will divide them still further - as the vote-off nears, emotions spill over and leave the group stunned.

programme.title: The Summit
programme.desc: Thrilling reality adventure series hosted by Ben Shephard. The 14 ordinary Brits who set off to climb one of New Zealand's highest peaks have now been reduced to nine as the treacherous terrain and brutal vote-offs claim more victims - in a dramatic twist, one of the group is now given an agonising decision by the Mountain's Keeper to choose someone to leave the mountain. After the emotional repercussions see everyone beginning to think more strategically, tensions increase when they are forced to camp in the wild and the group start to plot against one another - the following day leads to an encounter with a vast glacial lake that the climbers must cross to reach the next base camp. However, the Mountain's Keeper once more gets in on the act and forces the group into a situation which will divide them still further - as the vote-off nears, emotions spill over and leave the group stunned.

The 14 ordinary Brits who set off to climb one of New Zealand's highest peaks have now been reduced to nine as the treacherous terrain and brutal vote-offs claim more victims - in a dramatic twist, one of the group is now given an agonising decision by the Mountain's Keeper to choose someone to leave the mountain. After the emotional repercussions see everyone beginning to think more strategically, tensions increase when they are forced to camp in the wild and the group start to plot against one another - the following day leads to an encounter with a vast glacial lake that the climbers must cross to reach the next base camp. However, the Mountain's Keeper once more gets in on the act and forces the group into a situation which will divide them still further - as the vote-off nears, emotions spill over and leave the group stunned.

programme.title: The Summit
programme.desc: Thrilling reality adventure series hosted by Ben Shephard. The 14 ordinary Brits who set off to climb one of New Zealand's highest peaks have now been reduced to nine as the treacherous terrain and brutal vote-offs claim more victims - in a dramatic twist, one of the group is now given an agonising decision by the Mountain's Keeper to choose someone to leave the mountain. After the emotional repercussions see everyone beginning to think more strategically, tensions increase when they are forced to camp in the wild and the group start to plot against one another - the following day leads to an encounter with a vast glacial lake that the climbers must cross to reach the next base camp. However, the Mountain's Keeper once more gets in on the act and forces the group into a situation which will divide them still further - as the vote-off nears, emotions spill over and leave the group stunned.

programme.title: X The Unknown
programme.desc: 1956. Fantasy. Directed by Leslie Norman. Stars Dean Jagger, Edward Chapman & Leo McKern. A radioactive creature terrorises a remote Scottish village, will anyone be able to stop it? [S]

programme.title: Colonel March Investigates
programme.desc: 1953. Crime drama starring Boris Karloff, Joan Sims and Richard Wattis. Colonel March runs the Scotland Yard office for the Department of Queer Complaints and investigates 3 strange crimes. [S]

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: Who Killed the Surf Board? 1964. Directed by Don Taylor. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. Rising actress and beach queen, Tina Romaine, drops dead after surfing a difficult wave.

programme.title: Film Noir
programme.desc: Styles of Noir. 2022. Film Noir has become one of the most enduring and fascinating genres in cinema. The core ingredients would be experimented with in innovative ways in Europe and Hollywood. [S]

programme.title: Identity Unknown
programme.desc: 1960. War Drama. Directed by Frank Marshall. Stars Richard Wyler, Pauline Yates, Patricia Plunkett. Two reporters develop a relationship while investigating an aircraft accident. [S]

programme.title: East of Sudan
programme.desc: 1964. Adventure. Directed by Nathan Juran. Stars Anthony Quayle, Sylvia Sims & Derek Fowlds. Two colonial soldiers in 19th-century Africa risk their lives to save a governess and her charge. [S]

programme.title: Beyond the Curtain
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Directed by Compton Bennett. Starring Richard Greene, Eva Bartok and Marius Goring. East German refugee Karen finds herself back at home when the flight she works on is forced down. [S]

programme.title: Litter Defence Volunteers...
programme.desc: ...with Roy Hudd. 1968. The Litter Defence Volunteers stop litter from spoiling the streets, and with more public help they would do even better.

programme.title: The Lucy Show
programme.desc: Little Old Lucy. 1967. Stars Lucille Ball, Gale Gordon & Dennis Day. Mr. Mooney asks Lucy to disguise herself as a 'little old lady' to escort the aging bank president to the annual banquet. [S]

programme.title: The Broken Horseshoe
programme.desc: 1953. Crime drama. A hit and run victim is operated on by Dr. Fenton (Robert Beatty), the victim is later murdered and the doctor is involved. Starring Elizabeth Sellars. [S]

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: The Verdict. 1964. Directed by David Eady. Stars Cec Linder, Zena Marshall & Nigel Davenport. A big-time racketeer is deported back to Britain from America to find himself facing a murder rap. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Ladies of Sherwood. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Alan Wheatley. Is it the end for Arthur of Tetsbury having raised a shire levy can Robin him save him from an untimely demise. [S]

programme.title: Brandy for the Parson
programme.desc: 1951. Comedy. A young couple on a boating holiday off the Kent coast get caught up in a smuggling racket. Starring Kenneth More, Charles Hawtrey & Alfie Bass. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Under the Hammer
programme.desc: 1961. A look at the world of auctions and auctioneers, also with a glimpse at the various items sold and the different types of people drawn to the sale rooms.

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: Single or Double Indemnity. 1961. Stars John Ireland, Robert Ayres & Valentine Dyall. A train wreck kills everyone but Leon Little, believing it was murder Potter calls for John Hunter. [S]

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: 1971. I Can Be Happy Can't I? Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. Margaret spends her time with eligible widower Michael Armstrong. Edwin comes to a decision. (S2, E02) [S]

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
programme.desc: Rumpole and the Alternative Society. Stars: Leo McKern, Jane Asher & Nigel Gregory. Rumpole is content to be defending a drugs case. However, the outcome is not pleasing.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Inside Job. 1964. Stars Stratford Johns, Howard Pays & Derry Power. Detective Barlow investigates a mail van robbery when a quick getaway and an easy arrest reveal a new angle on the crime. [S]

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1972. Detective & Mystery Drama. Girl In Blue. Stars Alfred Burke, Ray Smith & Richard Leech. Marker is hired to discover her whereabouts of a missing Janice Summers, and bring her back home. [S]

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is back this week opening the Cellar Club with the next episode of the 1970s series, Supernatural! [S]

programme.title: Supernatural

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is back to introduce the next two treats in store for tonight. First we have Tales of Frankenstein, followed by the 1940s horror film The Devil Bat! [S]

programme.title: Tales of Frankenstein
programme.desc: 1958. Horror. Director: Curt Siodmak. Stars Anton Diffring, Helen Westcott & Don Megowan. Dr. Frankenstein has finished his creation, but the monster is unresponsive. He must try something new... [S]

programme.title: The Devil Bat

programme.title: The Summit
programme.desc: Thrilling reality adventure series hosted by Ben Shephard. The 14 ordinary Brits who set off to climb one of New Zealand's highest peaks have now been reduced to nine as the treacherous terrain and brutal vote-offs claim more victims - in a dramatic twist, one of the group is now given an agonising decision by the Mountain's Keeper to choose someone to leave the mountain. After the emotional repercussions see everyone beginning to think more strategically, tensions increase when they are forced to camp in the wild and the group start to plot against one another - the following day leads to an encounter with a vast glacial lake that the climbers must cross to reach the next base camp. However, the Mountain's Keeper once more gets in on the act and forces the group into a situation which will divide them still further - as the vote-off nears, emotions spill over and leave the group stunned.
